rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a plant leaf.

example.english: In autumn, trees start to shed leaf.
example.jyutping: cau1 tin1 di1 syu6 hoi1 ci2 lat1 jip6

rows.note: A speaker uses this fuller form when referring explicitly to an individual plant leaf.

example.english: Look at this leaf; it has a worm on it.
example.traditional: 你睇吓呢塊葉子，有條蟲喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 haa5 ni1 faai3 jip6 zi2 jau5 tiu4 cung4 wo3
